fact: Internet Society Pulse, from PeeringDB data of August 2026, shows SIXP Sudan (Sudan Internet Exchange Point) with four members at 1 Gbps each, three using RPKI, and no ASN joined or left in the previous 12 months; city not given.

PeeringDB's record for SIXP Sudan (Sudan Internet Exchange Point), operated by the National Information Center of Sudan in Khartoum, shows 4 peers, 4G total capacity and 50% IPv6, last updated 2020-01-22.

The National Information Center's WSIS Forum 2016 deck lists a National Internet Exchange Point among its services, saying it keeps traffic within Sudan, keeps service available nationally during an internet blackout and lowers internet costs; no members or city given; the deck carries no date, so the published date is used.
